emission_policy.trigger: BubbleVisible=true while the update dialog is hidden or minimized
emission_policy.no_update: silent and hides the update icon
emission_policy.note: All eleven states have stable names and severities, but the existing updater suppression policy intentionally emits cards only for actionable or exceptional transitions. A routine check and a routine no-update result remain quiet.

release_code_name.note: This repository has no bundled, verifier-backed dim-sum catalog or code-name field in its update feed. The card therefore shows the exact update version and does not invent a code name.

preserved_paths: update icon remains the details and action entry point
same-state progress callbacks do not create notification spam
install consent remains modal and defaults to No
download bytes are reverified before protected non-overwriting staging
the staged MSI remains write-delete locked across launch
Windows Installer stays interactive and owns completion and rollback status
restart and Restart Manager shutdown requests remain suppressed
no release code name is invented without a bundled verified catalog
note: The legacy update bubble transport is replaced by the shared bottom-right Material notification stack while the existing menu icon remains the action surface. Exact lifecycle state is passed separately from translated text, worker-thread updates are marshalled to the VCL main thread, and fixed translated status uses the approved libreoffice.update source. Version metadata is applied before text substitution; live progress remains in the existing update dialog, while paused/error cards include the current percent. Check and download errors state the real automatic retry behavior. Download-complete copy states that Windows Installer owns completion/rollback status. Install consent remains a default-No modal decision after immediate verification and protected staging. Source evidence only; native/runtime behavior is unverified.
